imprintNote: Enterprise instance of module 04. This file shares no key with seed/marketing-practice.json, at any level — the two instances share code and never data. Calendar slots, asset states and ledger entries that are not in this workspace are UNKNOWN rather than filled.

imprintCalendar.columnNote: No scheduled slots are in this workspace. Four empty weeks is the honest state of a calendar nobody has filled; four invented posts would read as a running programme.

imprintAssets.assetRemark: The publishing house itself. Catalog, releases and rights position are not in this workspace.
Carries its own palette — drafting-paper grey-green, survey ink, parcel teal. It does not inherit the enterprise navy and gold, and the token block it uses is its own rather than a variant.
Head of the sales line. Build state not observable from this workspace.
Carried as NTE-SLS-2026-FIELD-001 in the release register at eight of nine gate points. The ten stage gates it defines drive the pipeline board in module 09.
Forty-eight models. Whether the deck is complete is not observable from this workspace.
Carried in the application register in module 05, where its build state is also UNKNOWN. The two rows agree because neither claims anything.

imprintLedger.pubEntry: No publication is recorded. Authoring a book is not publishing it, and this ledger records the second thing only.

imprintPalette.paletteNote: Its own token block in src/ui/tokens.css, sharing no colour value with the enterprise palette. If it needed a navy or a gold it would be a variant of something else, which is what this block exists to prevent.
